vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
"You haven't earned that yet," A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Good eyes. Keep watching."
🍲 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Something's been at the pantry. Not an animal — the jars were moved, not broken."

Naomi has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek drew a trailing vine with yellow-green melon-sized fruits in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek was watching. Now they know Shea too.
the man in his 30s, with a scarred cheek spent the afternoon at the workbench, and the Arrow came apart in their hands. The materials are wasted.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek telling Liam about A person, maybe 40s, with a limp. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek telling Anas about A woman, maybe 20s. It's barely the same story now. That's what fires do.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +4 clean.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek glances around first. "People are saying things. About you. Is any of it true?" (Talk to A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek.)

👁️ You saw A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek palm 1 stick from the village stash and slide it into their pack.

You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 50s, with a broad frame telling A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek about Ruby. The truth left this story two fires ago. What's left is better theater.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek showed A person, maybe 50s, with a broad frame the Shea — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Natalie, Dieter, Debbie and Brooklyn met them at the door — 4 put down. Natalie, Dieter, Debbie, Brooklyn are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Liam just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Debbie, Boris and Ruby met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Debbie, Boris, Ruby are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Brian just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Brooklyn was watching. Now they know European Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Omar taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Mateo showed Ye-jun the European Elder — "remember it." Word gets around.
